recognize_zh: 與同系列相同的濃縮抹片：大量中到大型、核質比高、染色質細緻的非典型淋巴樣細胞，偶有核仁與細胞質空泡，並混有許多洋紅色的破裂細胞；看不到明顯的裂核，需靠免疫表現型確認為周邊化的濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Sheet of intermediate to large atypical lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio
Round to oval nuclei, occasionally indented, with fine to slightly clumped chromatin
Small nucleoli visible in a subset of cells
Scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm; a few cells contain small vacuoles
Many ruptured cells with pink-magenta smeared chromatin
Red cells are sparse relative to the lymphoid population, suggesting a concentrated preparation
describe_en: The concentrated smear shows a monotonous infiltrate of intermediate to large atypical lymphoid cells with high N:C ratios. Nuclei are round to oval, occasionally indented, with fine to slightly clumped chromatin and small nucleoli in some cells. Cytoplasm is scant and basophilic, with occasional small vacuoles, and numerous disrupted cells with smeared magenta chromatin are present. Classic small cleaved centrocyte-like cells are not prominent. Findings are consistent with leukemic involvement by a B-cell lymphoma with atypical, large-cell morphology; in context this represents peripheralizing follicular lymphoma, to be confirmed by flow cytometry and BCL2 rearrangement studies.

ddx.vs: Blasts are TdT and CD34 positive with very fine chromatin, while FL cells are mature CD10+ B cells with surface light chain restriction.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma in leukemic phase
ddx.vs: Large-cell transformation can look identical; tissue biopsy showing diffuse sheets of large cells is needed to distinguish it from FL with atypical circulating cells.
Cyclin D1 and SOX11 positivity with CD10 negativity identify MCL.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with many sharply punched-out vacuoles and a near-100% Ki-67 with MYC rearrangement without BCL2 rearrangement.
